output_list.criticism: The transferFrom function in the BasicToken contract has an integer overflow vulnerability. This vulnerability allows an attacker to set any user's balance to a high value, potentially leading to a loss of funds for the victim.
The unfreeze function in the ETY contract doesn't check the tokens totalSupply, allowing attackers to unfreeze the contract.

The mint function in the ETY contract has a token devalue/typo constructor. This vulnerability allows the ICO contract to mint tokens without any restrictions, potentially leading to a loss of funds for the ICO contract.
